title: GDEFLATE bitstream specification
relevance: The formal specification of GDEFLATE, defining the bit-swizzle layout that enables 32-way parallel DEFLATE decompression.

title: GDeflate Reference Implementation (DirectStorage)
relevance: Reference implementation showing GDEFLATE as a reformatted DEFLATE stream extracting 32-way parallelism without increasing stream size.

title: Accelerating Lossless GPU Compression with New Flexible Interfaces in NVIDIA nvCOMP
relevance: Describes NVIDIA's nvCOMP library including GDEFLATE GPU decompression achieving high throughput on A100/V100.

title: Accelerating JPEG Decompression on GPUs
venue: IEEE International Conference on High Performance Computing (HiPC)
relevance: Evaluates parallel codeword location at arbitrary bitstream positions, related technique for enabling parallel chunk decompression.
